 2. Protection: Legal instruments and purview
The national legal instruments are common to all three spa towns FL, KV, ML:
The Act no. 183/2006 Coll., …

On urban planning and builidng… (Building Act)

The Act no. 114/1992 Coll., …

On nature and landscape protection… Environment
Protection Act)

The Act no. 20/1987 Coll., …

On the state monuments care…(Heritage Preserv Act)

The Act no. 289/1995 Coll., …

On forests and changes… (The Forests Act)

Decree of the Ministry of Health On resources of natural resources of mineral waters
no. 423/2001 Coll., …
The Act no. 164/2001 Coll., …

On natural healing resources… (The Spa Act)

The newest regulatory instruments at the local level for Mariánské Lázně :
1) Strategic Plan for further Development of Mariánské Lázně 2016 to 2031 (approved)
2) Urban Development Plan of Mariánské Lázně 20019-2026 (in progress for approval)
3) Regeneration Program for Mariánské Lázně 2019-2030 (approved)
For the list of Int’l conventions and recommendations approved
by the state parties is see LMP ML on pages 54ff.

a. Authorities responsible for site management of the
component parts FL, KV, ML

• Regional – KvK Region gov., Governor of the Karlovy Vary Region,
NPÚ Loket, Czech Spas Salons of Evrope
• Federal – N/A (not applicable)

(National Heritage Institute)
